idea-plugin.name: Maven Resource Overlay
idea-plugin.description:
Maven Resource Overlay

Automatically applies Maven resource filtering and <webResources> overlays from active profiles when IntelliJ builds exploded WAR or JAR artifacts.

Partial fix for the long-standing IntelliJ limitation (IDEA-25934) where the artifact builder ignores maven-war-plugin configuration from Maven profiles.

What it does

  • Copies profile-specific <webResources> into the artifact output, overlaying files per the active Maven profile
  • Applies ${...} property substitution in resources configured with <filtering>true</filtering>
  • Loads properties from external filter files (<build><filters>) at both project and profile level, with correct Maven priority order
  • Filters deployment descriptors when <filteringDeploymentDescriptors> is enabled
  • Respects <nonFilteredFileExtensions> for binary files
  • Respects <includes> and <excludes> patterns
  • Caches results — skips reprocessing when nothing changed
  • Shows processing details in the Build tool window

Supported project types

  • WAR — exploded WAR artifacts with <webResources> and resource filtering
  • JAR — JAR artifacts with <resources><filtering>true</filtering>

How it works

  1. Activate a Maven profile in the Maven tool window
  2. Build your exploded artifact (Build → Build Artifacts)
  3. The plugin automatically post-processes the artifact output
  4. Check the Build tool window for details

Built-in properties

The following Maven-standard properties are available for ${...} substitution in both file contents and path configurations (<directory>, <include>, <exclude>, <targetPath>, <filter>):

  • Project: project.groupId, project.artifactId, project.version, project.name, project.packaging, project.basedir
  • Build dirs: project.build.directory, project.build.sourceDirectory, project.build.outputDirectory, project.build.testSourceDirectory, project.build.testOutputDirectory, project.build.finalName
  • Aliases: basedir, groupId, artifactId, version, pom.groupId, pom.artifactId, pom.version, pom.basedir
  • System: user.dir, user.home, user.name, java.home, java.version, os.name, os.arch, file.separator, path.separator, line.separator

Limitations

  • Environment variables (${env.VAR}) and settings.xml properties are not supported.
  • Only ${property} syntax is supported. The @property@ delimiter style (Spring Boot) is not supported.
  • Multi-module projects: each module must be built as a separate artifact. Parent property inheritance works only when both POMs are in the project.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Property substitution in paths: ${...} placeholders are now resolved in <directory>, <include>, <exclude>, <targetPath>, and <filter> paths — fixes "WebResource dir not found" when pom uses e.g. <directory>${basedir}/profiles/${build.profile.id}</directory>
  • 30+ built-in Maven properties: added project.groupId, project.packaging, project.name, project.build.directory, project.build.finalName, short aliases (groupId, artifactId, version), pom.* aliases, and Java system properties (user.dir, user.home, java.version, etc.)
  • Property value resolution: ${...} inside property values themselves are resolved (e.g. <custom.dir>${basedir}/custom</custom.dir>)
  • Early basedir: basedir is defined before filter file loading, so ${basedir} works in <filter> paths
  • Output file content hashing for reliable cache invalidation

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • WAR and JAR artifact support
  • Profile-based resource filtering and webResources overlays
  • External filter file support (<build><filters>) with correct Maven priority order
  • Build tool window integration
  • Incremental cache to skip unchanged builds
